reviews.x: I just got these in today and I can't contain my excitement!!! I got two orders, so 40 total. They are exactly as pictured and the bands are covered and soft, they're also super flexible and could fit all head sizes! We'll see how they hold up but I just love these and you can't beat the price!!!

Love Disneyland and having new ears for each visit to match the theme/ color of my outfit, but don’t love paying over $30 for ears each time! Enter this solution: buying a pack of 20 ears for super cheap and embellishing/ customizing them for each outfit. I made this pair (pictured) with red and blue rhinestones. Good quality and a great base for a craft project. Not as big as the ears you’d get at Disneyland, but they do the trick and are super cute. Very excited for more projects to come!

reviews.t: Great quality and the came fast
reviews.x: These are great much better quality than I expected they came in good time as well.perfect party favor
This is the best product. They are very stretchy and comfortable for adults. We wore them for hours with no discomfort. They are adorable.

Very impressed with the quality of these Mickey and Minnie ears! These were great party favors for my daughter’s 11th Birthday party. We had one at each place setting. I ordered the 20 pack. It was 10 Mickey and 10 Red/white dot Bow Minnie headbands. Comfortable to wear and can fit kids and adults. I definitely recommend these to add to your party!

Worked great as party favors without spending a fortune. The kids and even some adults loved them. No one broke theirs, only negative thing I could say was there was some dried glue on some of the ears. Not that big of a deal.

Used these for my daughters Minnie Mouse themed birthday party! These were a hit! Worn by all ages ranging from my 4 month old son to my 88 year old Grandparents. Very stretchy and soft headband. Ears were soft but not flimsy. Stayed upright the whole time you wear them. It was nice to have both Minnie and Mickey options for the kids to choose from. I wish they had a lighter pink option, but these meshed well with the girly color scheme of her party regardless!

I was worried about the quality because of how inexpensive they are. The quality is great! Very cute and durable. I used them as favors for my daughter’s birthday. Kids ranging in ages from 18m to 9 years were wearing them and they held up perfectly! My 2 year old has still been wearing hers around the house and it is still in perfect condition. That says a lot!

Purchased these ears for all the kids at my sons birthday party. They were super cute and came exactly as described. We had no issues or breakage at the party and the kids were running, dancing, and playing like crazy! These are a great and a great price for a party favor.

I bought these for my one year old’s Minnie Mouse themed birthday party. The guests loved these, and I personally think they’re adorable! The Minnie bow is true to the color shown in the pictures, and I found that they fit comfortably (to the point I forgot they were on while giving her a bath!)  Overall, they’re super comfortable and are a great touch for any Minnie/Mickey themed event.

I bought these for my son’s second birthday. We had ages 2-61. They fit everyone perfectly and were so comfortable you forgot you had them on. They were made really well and very durable not one pair broke. People thought I paid way more than I did. I wouldn’t even think twice about buying these again and highly recommend

reviews.t: Sturdy great quality fits adults and kids and my 2 yr old baby.
reviews.x: These ears were such a cute touch to our party. Kids babies and adults alike wore them and they were so cute for pictures. Would definitely buy again if I ever hosted another Mickey party. I love that the set came with both Mickey and Minnie ears. Thank you for an awesome product
[[VIDEOID:6035d2794d4e50b4e2098e96fd1ee9e]] Great Great Great buy. Definitely worth your money. Looks and feels strong and sturdy. Will use them as party hats.
These were super cute and good quality especially that price! All the kids loved them for my sons first birthday

I bought these for my nephew's birthday party and I wasn't expecting much as it was just for that day. But I was surprised by the quality of this product. The material is soft and the finishing is very nice too. None of them were defective and it's something the kids can continue to wear after the party because it is a good material.

A party for my grandbabies with a Mickey Mouse theme was a big hit when not only children but adults wore these.  Only thing was we did not order enough.  Our photos show how cute we looked.  They were not tight on our heads but stayed on for hours and hours.

These Mickey and Minnie headbands were the talk of the party. They are very affordable but really high quality. The stood up to a 2 year olds punishment all day. They are very cute. I highly recommend them.
[[VIDEOID:1c63f01075a95b7bf0acc14a6d959546]] These are perfect. The red bows are removable, however they will leave glue residue behind. Fit both adults and children. Perfect for crafting.
[[VIDEOID:c775210b25fcf3950c49a67f82c51f61]] We was Cute

reviews.t: Cute. More for Kids, but adults can wear them
reviews.x: Got this to distribute to our 8 adult kids and 3 grand children. They are soft and made VERY well, held up to a full day at Disneyland with comfort.  The ears are a bit close together for adults, but still looked cute. I would say YES to recommending, especially for the value. Nobody's tore, failed or other disasters, and they were put on and off all day to take off shirts, etc.  Loved the bow for Minnie and the plain ears for Mickey

I really only needed 5 of these headbands for my family but when I was researching Mickey headbands, the cost of 1 is ridiculous, so when I found this set of 20 to be cheaper than 1 "disney" one, I was sold. So what if they are cheap... they do the job! I highly recommend these -- you can use them for so many things... birthday party, themed play dates, Disney trips, etc. We are wearing them on our Disney Cruise!

I was very pleasantly surprised with the quality of these. I got them for my sons 1st birthday party so everyone can wear Mickey ears instead of a traditional party hat. We haven’t used them yet but my husband and I both tried them on and decided we’ll easily be able to wear them for a few hours for the party. My husband has a large head and he was sure they wouldn’t fit him but they do!

I really was hoping that these were not going to be cheaply made for the price. I bought these for my sons birthday party and i tell you what they are perfect and way better than expected!! So happy with the purchase
Standard Mickey ears in good quality. Added vinyl and they stuck very well. Will buy again.

These were a huge hit! I made some goody bags and threw one of these in each of them and dropped them off for each of my family. My son turned one and so we threw him a zoom party when everyone joined they had they’re cute little ears on. It was the perfect little touch that brought his Mickey Mouse themed birthday party altogether !!!!! So content with this purchase. Great price for the quality. Would totally recommend!!!!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the quality as better than expected for the low price, describing the ears as sturdy and durable with no breakage.
The headbands are commonly described as soft, stretchy, and comfortable, fitting both kids and adults.
Many customers use these as party favors for Mickey/Minnie themed birthdays and consider them a great value.
The ears are widely described as cute and adorable, matching the pictures and descriptions.
A few reviewers note minor issues like dried glue on some ears, though it is not considered a big deal.

qa.q: Do these fit adults or are they kid-sized?
qa.answer: These fit both adults and children, not just kid-sized [1][2][3][4][6]. One reviewer notes they are "more for kids, but adults can wear them" and that the ears are a bit close together for adults [5].

claims.text: They fit everyone from ages 2-61 perfectly [1].
They are very stretchy and comfortable for adults [2].
They fit adults and kids and a 2-year-old baby [3].
Both children and adults wore them [4].
They are more for kids, but adults can wear them, though the ears are a bit close together for adults [5].
They fit both adults and children [6].

qa.q: Are the headbands comfortable enough to wear all day?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews report all-day comfort: one wore them a full day at Disneyland with comfort [1], another wore them for hours with no discomfort [4], and another forgot they were on [6]. Others describe them as soft and stretchy [2][3][5].

claims.text: They held up to a full day at Disneyland with comfort.
They were worn for hours with no discomfort.
One wearer forgot they were on.
The bands are soft and stretchy.

qa.q: Do they feel sturdy or flimsy?
qa.answer: Reviewers describe the ears as sturdy and durable, with no breakage even while kids ran, danced, and played [2][5][6]. One reviewer noted they held up perfectly across ages 18 months to 9 years and remained in perfect condition after continued use [6].

claims.text: Reviewers describe the ears as sturdy and durable.
There was no breakage at the party even while kids were running, dancing, and playing.

qa.q: Is there a strong plastic or chemical smell?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Are they good value for a 20-pack?
qa.answer: Yes, reviewers describe the 20-pack as good value, calling it a "great price for the quality" [3] and saying "you can't beat the price" [2], with others calling it "worth your money" [6] and good quality "especially that price" [4].
